verdict.rationale: Milvus is a vector database, not an agent or AI host, so consuming tools from plugged-in MCP servers (the MCP client role) is outside its product category. The evidence shows only the opposite role: an official MCP server that exposes Milvus to AI applications (milvus-docs-23, milvus-probe-3). That server-side capability belongs to a separate story and does not make this client axis applicable.
